description: Montana motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Montana rider who is age 18 or older
options: Must wear one on every trip
questions.explanation: The Montana age rule is aimed at riders 17 and younger. Some states add a novice or insurance condition, so read the statute before riding without a helmet.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Montana?

provenance.manual: 61-9-417. Headgear required for minor motorcycle riders, MCA

questions.q: What does Montana law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Montana: only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow.
questions.remember: Montana between lanes: filtering only, in stopped or slow traffic.

provenance.manual: 61-8-392. Lane filtering for motorcycles -- definition, MCA

questions.q: What does Montana require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Montana: eye protection is not required by state law.
questions.remember: Montana eyewear: not required by state law.
